rationale: AMLAS is consistently presented as a six-stage, primarily offline-supervised ML-component baseline requiring complementary system and domain assurance. The conventional-software bridge and proposed assurance rule extend the project argument around, rather than replacing, AMLAS; the crosswalk explicitly leaves plant/controller, monitor, operations, and authorization outside the component method.
limitations: This does not verify AMLAS text or certify the project's crosswalk interpretation.
No artifact claims AMLAS alone is sufficient for the road or air release.
